themes.title: Populist Rally Fever Across Borders
themes.blurb: Right-wing populist movements in both the US and Norway are experiencing heightened momentum, driven by high-profile campaign appearances and record-breaking poll numbers. Donald Trump's nationwide midterm rallies mirror Frp's historic surge in Norwegian polling under Sylvi Listhaug.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and Vance ramp up high-energy midterm campaign rallies across multiple states to energize young voters and the conservative base.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Frp hits a record-high 31.9% in national polls under Sylvi Listhaug, reflecting strong populist electoral momentum.
